ScaleCell: a foundation model for cell-type annotation across tissues

Posted November 11, 2026. Okafor A, Lindqvist M, Tanaka R, et al. Preprint, not peer-reviewed.

Abstract: We pretrain a transformer on 48 million cells from 31 tissues. On 12 held-out datasets, ScaleCell reaches a mean adjusted Rand index of 0.71, against 0.64 for the best existing method (scANVI). Full text: PDF unavailable at this time.

A benchmark of 14 single-cell data integration methods

Published November 10, 2026, Genome Biology Methods. Reyes P, Chen L, et al. DOI 10.5555/gb.2026.118. Peer-reviewed.

We compare 14 integration methods on 8 datasets (1.2 million cells) with 10 metrics. No method ranks first on all datasets; scVI ranks first on 5 of 8.
